title: Haunted Downtown
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Looking for another Montreal?

Guided by a professional actor and storyteller, this haunted tour is sure to appeal to history buffs, ghost hunters and Allowe’en enthusiasts with its tales of frightening paranormal activity and ghosts haunting unusual places – in the heart of downtown Montreal.

Listen to the nauseating and twisted “legend of the red cross”, as well as the new university residence of Concordia, the Grey Nuns’ former motherhouse where a mysterious crypt is located.

Visit haunted houses, including a run-down squat on “Overdose” Avenue and a spooky old funeral home converted into one of Montreal’s trendiest nightclubs. Sometimes customers don’t ask for so much, especially if they dare to visit the women’s aisles and attic.

And many more stories to discover!
